title: Senior Data Scientist
raw_text:
InsightAnalytics is a rapidly growing B2B analytics platform. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our core ML team. In this role, you will build predictive models, deploy them into production, and run complex A/B tests to measure impact.

What you will do:
- Build and deploy robust machine learning models using Python, Scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
- Query large datasets using SQL and optimize data pipelines for model training.
- Work closely with engineering to deploy models using modern MLOps practices.
- Design and analyze A/B experiments to evaluate model performance and feature rollouts.
- Mentor junior data scientists and translate complex statistical results for business stakeholders.

What we are looking for:
- 4+ years of professional data science experience.
- Deep expertise in Python and SQL.
- Proven track record of putting ML models into production.

Nice to have:
- Experience with PySpark or other big data tools.
- Familiarity with MLOps frameworks like MLflow or Kubeflow.
- Cloud experience with AWS or GCP.
